description: This horizontal grouped bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model across various applied optimizations for two different fine-tuned models. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," listing five optimizations from top to bottom: Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal axis represents the value, labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large," using a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to just beyond 0.003, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.001. The chart features grouped horizontal bars, with a legend below the chart titled "Model" indicating that orange bars represent the "NESAC ft model" and green bars represent the "SESHA ft model." Within each optimization category on the vertical axis, the orange bar is positioned above the green bar. Every bar is explicitly annotated with its exact numeric value at its right end. For the "Normalised" category, the NESAC model is 0.00334 and the SESHA model is 0.00323. For "Add Spacing," the values are 0.00319 (NESAC) and 0.00344 (SESHA). Under "Remove Spacing," NESAC is 0.00311 and SESHA is 0.00306. For "Americanisms," NESAC is 0.00299 and SESHA is 0.00302. Finally, for "Dates," NESAC is 0.00257 and SESHA is 0.00228. The shortest bar in the chart is the SESHA ft model under the "Dates" category with a value of 0.00228, while the longest bar is the SESHA ft model under the "Add Spacing" category at 0.00344. The categories are arranged in a generally descending order based on their overall values from top to bottom.
